reason: The requested feature is implemented and consistent with the existing checkout flow. web/index.html adds a 'Pay now' button (id=pay) and a result paragraph; web/app.js wires the click handler to POST {cart, method:'card'} to /api/checkout, renders the success message from amount_cents/status/method, renders errors, and only disables the button while a request is in flight (setBusy), with /api/status treated as informational only. The response shape consumed by app.js (amount_cents, status, method, error) matches what checkout.create_checkout and the Handler produce. Tests cover the unit path (create_checkout) and server HTTP path (valid cart 200, empty cart 400, unsupported method 400), matching the client behavior. No defect is evidenced; the remaining items noted in the terminal result (placeholder cart source, no idempotency, no telemetry) are non-blocking follow-ups, not defects in the requested feature.
